messages:
tara-docs: Quick one: opened a PR to add a short autoscale mini-reference to the Dedicated provisioning guide (https://git.redwood/docs/pull/558). Need 3 tiny things before merge:
1) a 3-line k8s pod annotation example for tenant->reserved binding
2) a minimal inline Terraform + 1-line Python SDK example for create_autoscale_policy
3) one-sentence SLA exclusion list (legal asked for explicit causes)

sam-eng: I'll do TF + Python. TF should be inline resource, minimal fields only.

oliver-infra: k8s snippet (OSS note included):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: worker-sample
  annotations:
    redwood/tenant-id: "tenant-alpha"
    redwood/reserved: "true"
spec:
  priorityClassName: redwood-dedicated  # OSS: use high-priority or create this class
  containers:
  - name: runner
    image: redwood/llm-runtime:stable
```

sam-eng: TF (inline):
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_autoscale_policy" "p" {
  tenant_id    = "tenant-alpha"
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 4
  cpu_target   = 70
  burst_policy { enabled = true, burst_capacity = 1 }
}
```
Python (one-liner):
```py
policy = DedicatedClient().create_autoscale_policy("tenant-alpha", min_replicas=1, max_replicas=4, cpu_target=70, burst_capacity=1)
```

jenna-techwriter: Draft SLA sentence: "Evictions caused by cloud provider preemption/maintenance, operator-initiated node drains, or tenant misconfiguration (e.g., missing `redwood/reserved` annotation) are excluded from uptime credits." OK to add?

chris-sre: that's fine. add an example line: "Exempt example: spot instance reclamation during provider maintenance."

docs-bot: linkcheck started: found 1 stale link (/docs/legacy/dedicated-module).

tara-docs: jenna removed the stale link in branch. requesting re-run. Will merge once linkcheck is green and snippets are in. Thanks! :tada:
